kernel: Kokkos::Impl::CudaReductionsFunctor<FunctorType,void,false,false>::scalar_intra_warp_reduction (broadcast tail), inlined into cuda_parallel_launch_local_memory<ParallelReduce<RwSumFunctor, RangePolicy<Cuda>, InvalidType, Cuda>> (driver: scalar parallel_reduce, n = 1000, double)

sites.source: *value = *(value - lane_id);   (the store half: lane 0 stores back into its own slot, i.e. slot[warp base + 0], the value it already holds)
sites.operation: st.shared.f64 (SASS STS.64 [R9], Rx; R9 = &value = this lane's own slot; executed by every lane, the conflicting one is lane 0)

sites.source: *value = *(value - lane_id);   (the load half: every lane loads lane 0's slot, value - lane_id)
sites.operation: ld.shared.f64 (SASS LDS.64 Rx, [R0]; R0 = value - lane_id = slot of lane 0 of the warp; the conflicting readers are lanes 1..31)

thread_pair_example: block 0, warp 0: thread 0 (lane 0) executes STS.64 to slot 0 of the warp (self-assignment, same value) while thread 1 (lane 1) executes LDS.64 from slot 0 (lanes 1..31 all read slot 0). The last __syncwarp(mask) of the tree loop is at L549 (before both); no barrier separates the load of lane 1 from the store of lane 0. Same pair in every warp of every block (the width-32 call and the width-(blockDim/32) call, both in scalar_intra_block_reduction).
class_reason: Both accesses are plain shared-memory accesses (Scalar* is not volatile; PTX ld.shared.f64 / st.shared.f64 with no .volatile/.relaxed/atomic qualifier; SASS LDS.64/STS.64 without a .STRONG token). Two lanes of one warp access one shared address, one of them a store, with no ordering between them -> data race of two plain accesses (DR). No strong or atomic access is part of the pair, so no SC component. The store is value-preserving (lane 0 rewrites the value it already holds), so results are always correct; whether a detector filters same-value stores is a detector question, not part of the ground truth.
buggy_expected: The pair is reported as DR, intra-warp: the STS.64 and the LDS.64 of source line 551 (both roles on L551, as in the racecheck output quoted in the fix commit message: Read at :551 and Write at :551, 144 hazards for n=1). The buggy program also contains the second hazard below (ReduceScan.hpp:575 write vs Parallel_Range.hpp:321 read), which is not the target pair.

residual_sites.operation: st.shared.f64 / SASS STS.64 [R7.X8+-0x8] (in the last-block instance, where result = shared + (blockDim.y - 1); the other instance stores to global with st.global.f64 / STG.E.64)
ld.shared.u32 / SASS LDS R9, [R0.X4] (32-bit word loads of the 8-byte value, threads with threadIdx.y < word_count = 2)

fixed.reason: The targeted pair (L551 broadcast) is absent: the fix wraps the broadcast in 'if (lane_id != 0)' (L551-L553 of the fixed file; the store and load are now at L552, SASS @P1 LDS.64 [R0] / @P1 STS.64 [R9] predicated off for lane 0), so lane 0 no longer stores into the slot that lanes 1..31 read. The fixed program is NOT report-free: it still contains the separate hazard quoted in the fix commit message (racecheck 'After': Write ReduceScan.hpp:577 vs Read Parallel_Range.hpp:321, 4 hazards), an intra-warp RAW for the 8-byte result because the __syncthreads at Parallel_Range.hpp:316 only runs when WarpSize < word_count. That residual is the same in the buggy variant (L575 there) and must not be scored against the L551 pair.

sass_notes: sm_89 SASS of the driver (cuobjdump/nvdisasm -g, kernel cuda_parallel_launch_local_memory<ParallelReduce<RwSumFunctor,...>>), buggy: L551 appears 4 times (2 call sites x 2 inlined scalar_intra_block_reduction instances), each as a pair LDS.64 R14,[R0] ... STS.64 [R9],R14 at offsets 0x0560/0x05d0, 0x0a40/0x0a70, 0x11c0/0x11f0, 0x1660/0x1680 (the load feeds the store directly, load first). Neither carries a .STRONG token (plain LDS/STS; volatile is not involved at this site, the pointer is a plain Scalar*). The tree loop above it (L545-L549) has a YIELD at L546 but NO WARPSYNC for the __syncwarp(mask) at L549: ptxas removed it (full mask), so between the last tree step and the broadcast nothing in the SASS orders the lanes. Sync instructions of the region (line-table attribution): BAR.SYNC at L566 (0x05e0, 0x1200) and L591 (0x03d0), WARPSYNC 0xffffffff attributed to L566 (0x11d0, directly before the BAR.SYNC at 0x1200); none is attributed to L549 or to the __syncwarp(0xffffffff) at L572. Fixed: the same pair is @P1 LDS.64 [R0] / @P1 STS.64 [R9] at L552 (offsets 0x0570/0x05e0, 0x0a50/0x0a80, 0x11c0/0x1200, 0x1670/0x1690), predicated by lane_id != 0. The residual STS.64 at L577 is at 0x16b0 (fixed) with LDS R9,[R0.X4] at Parallel_Range.hpp:321, 0x1810.
